item.title: Hire of Laundry Equipment
item.description:
Advertised value: GBP 24,000 Status: active Deadline: 2026-12-04T12:00:00+00:00
Hull City Council (The Authority) is seeking tenders from interested organisations to provide a Laundry and Associated Equipment hire service to a residential care home within the Hull City Council boundary. The tender is an open procedure consisting of a one stage process. The contract is anticipated to commence 01 February 2027 ending by 31 December 2029 . The Authority has estimated the value of the Services to be £7,000-£8,000 per annum. The estimated value is given in good faith to assist tenderers in making their submissions, it should not be interpreted as an undertaking to purchase any goods, services or works to any particular value by the Authority and does not form part of the Contract. Further information is contained within the tender documentation. Please ensure all tender submission documents are completed as detailed. Incomplete bids will be eliminated from further process.
